judgement_shape: teacher_output_v2 raw judgement; new profile adds local L1 references
family_reference_rule: row:<minimum source_row_id within identical family>:L1; path=[family]; G<excel_row>
reference_identity: source occurrence and full path; never formal concept ID
granularity_policy: prefer evidenced level 2; retain directly evidenced level 0/1; never expand downward
mapping_policy: supported and scope_review are separate from granularity; never promote scope_review
support_policy: every direction linked to a supported label must declare supported with explicit_direction or research_activity evidence
projection_policy: supported direct labels project ancestors into derived_projections only; duplicate supported ancestor for the same direction is rejected
validation_base: unmodified teacher_output_v2 validator; checks declared roles, not person attribution or semantic entailment
execution: offline only; preview by default; explicit write creates a new directory and refuses any existing target
